metadata.name: A20
metadata.description: label for the algorithm cell

cels.v: ▼ NanoSteg algorithm — the ENTIRE blind LSB steganography as hand-written WebAssembly text (FNV-1a64 seed, splitmix64 PRNG, collision-avoided carrier probe over R/G/B LSBs, the 'NS' header). This cell IS the program; edit it and the embed/decode formulas re-fire. Its live instance is captured by nanosteg.host so the marshalling verbs can read/write its memory.

metadata.name: A21
metadata.description: THE ALGORITHM, on the surface (R10): the complete NanoSteg WAT module — hash_password (FNV-1a64), splitmix64, the collision-avoided carrier probe, LSB read/write, the NS header, exporting mem/embed/decode. Compiled by the wat compiler; nanosteg.host captures its live instance. Edit it and the embed/decode formulas recompile live.

cels.f:
(module
  ;; NanoSteg v1 — password-seeded pseudo-random LSB steganography, blind.
  ;; Pure integer math. The host copies the RGBA buffer + password + payload
  ;; into this memory at fixed offsets, then calls hash_password + embed/decode.
  ;;
  ;; Memory map (protocol constants, shared with the nanosteg glue):
  ;;   0x000000  RGBA8 pixel buffer      4*W*H bytes  (alpha never touched)
  ;;   0x800000  used-carrier bitset     ceil(3*W*H/8) bytes
  ;;   0xA00000  password bytes          (host writes, len passed to hash_password)
  ;;   0xA10000  payload bytes           (in on embed, out on decode)
  ;;   0xB00000  header scratch          7 bytes: 'N' 'S' 0x01 + u32-LE length
  (memory (export "mem") 1)

  (global $seed  (mut i64) (i64.const 0))
  (global $state (mut i64) (i64.const 0))

  ;; --- FNV-1a 64 over password bytes [ptr, ptr+len) -> $seed ---------------
  (func (export "hash_password") (param $ptr i32) (param $len i32)
    (local $h i64) (local $i i32)
    (local.set $h (i64.const 0xCBF29CE484222325))          ;; FNV offset basis
    (local.set $i (i32.const 0))
    (block $done (loop $lp
      (br_if $done (i32.ge_u (local.get $i) (local.get $len)))
      (local.set $h (i64.xor (local.get $h)
        (i64.extend_i32_u (i32.load8_u (i32.add (local.get $ptr) (local.get $i))))))
      (local.set $h (i64.mul (local.get $h) (i64.const 0x100000001B3)))   ;; FNV prime
      (local.set $i (i32.add (local.get $i) (i32.const 1)))
      (br $lp)))
    (global.set $seed (local.get $h)))

  ;; --- splitmix64 next -> i64 ---------------------------------------------
  (func $next (result i64)
    (local $z i64)
    (global.set $state (i64.add (global.get $state) (i64.const 0x9E3779B97F4A7C15)))
    (local.set $z (global.get $state))
    (local.set $z (i64.mul (i64.xor (local.get $z) (i64.shr_u (local.get $z) (i64.const 30))) (i64.const 0xBF58476D1CE4E5B9)))
    (local.set $z (i64.mul (i64.xor (local.get $z) (i64.shr_u (local.get $z) (i64.const 27))) (i64.const 0x94D049BB133111EB)))
    (i64.xor (local.get $z) (i64.shr_u (local.get $z) (i64.const 31))))

  ;; --- used-carrier bitset at 0x800000 ------------------------------------
  (func $is_used (param $idx i32) (result i32)
    (i32.and
      (i32.shr_u
        (i32.load8_u (i32.add (i32.const 0x800000) (i32.shr_u (local.get $idx) (i32.const 3))))
        (i32.and (local.get $idx) (i32.const 7)))
      (i32.const 1)))
  (func $mark (param $idx i32)
    (local $addr i32)
    (local.set $addr (i32.add (i32.const 0x800000) (i32.shr_u (local.get $idx) (i32.const 3))))
    (i32.store8 (local.get $addr)
      (i32.or (i32.load8_u (local.get $addr))
        (i32.shl (i32.const 1) (i32.and (local.get $idx) (i32.const 7))))))
  (func $clear_bitset (param $C i32)
    (memory.fill (i32.const 0x800000) (i32.const 0)
      (i32.div_u (i32.add (local.get $C) (i32.const 7)) (i32.const 8))))

  ;; --- collision-avoided random probe: draw + linear-probe + mark -> idx --
  (func $claim (param $C i32) (result i32)
    (local $idx i32)
    (local.set $idx (i32.wrap_i64 (i64.rem_u (call $next) (i64.extend_i32_u (local.get $C)))))
    (block $found (loop $lp
      (br_if $found (i32.eqz (call $is_used (local.get $idx))))
      (local.set $idx (i32.rem_u (i32.add (local.get $idx) (i32.const 1)) (local.get $C)))
      (br $lp)))
    (call $mark (local.get $idx))
    (local.get $idx))

  ;; carrier k -> rgba byte offset 4*(k/3)+(k%3): R/G/B of each pixel, skip A
  (func $carrier_off (param $idx i32) (result i32)
    (i32.add
      (i32.mul (i32.div_u (local.get $idx) (i32.const 3)) (i32.const 4))
      (i32.rem_u (local.get $idx) (i32.const 3))))
  (func $put_bit (param $idx i32) (param $b i32)
    (local $off i32)
    (local.set $off (call $carrier_off (local.get $idx)))
    (i32.store8 (local.get $off)
      (i32.or (i32.and (i32.load8_u (local.get $off)) (i32.const 0xFE))
              (i32.and (local.get $b) (i32.const 1)))))
  (func $get_bit (param $idx i32) (result i32)
    (i32.and (i32.load8_u (call $carrier_off (local.get $idx))) (i32.const 1)))

  ;; --- embed(w,h,len) -> 0 ok | -1 capacity -------------------------------
  (func (export "embed") (param $w i32) (param $h i32) (param $len i32) (result i32)
    (local $C i32) (local $K i32) (local $i i32) (local $byte i32) (local $bit i32) (local $bi i32)
    (local.set $C (i32.mul (i32.const 3) (i32.mul (local.get $w) (local.get $h))))
    (local.set $K (i32.add (i32.const 56) (i32.mul (i32.const 8) (local.get $len))))
    (if (i32.gt_u (local.get $K) (local.get $C)) (then (return (i32.const -1))))
    ;; header at 0xB00000: 'N' 'S' 0x01 + u32-LE len
    (i32.store8 (i32.const 0xB00000) (i32.const 0x4E))
    (i32.store8 (i32.const 0xB00001) (i32.const 0x53))
    (i32.store8 (i32.const 0xB00002) (i32.const 0x01))
    (i32.store  offset=0xB00003 align=1 (i32.const 0) (local.get $len))
    (global.set $state (global.get $seed))
    (call $clear_bitset (local.get $C))
    (local.set $i (i32.const 0))
    (block $done (loop $lp
      (br_if $done (i32.ge_u (local.get $i) (local.get $K)))
      (local.set $bi (i32.shr_u (local.get $i) (i32.const 3)))
      (local.set $byte (if (result i32) (i32.lt_u (local.get $bi) (i32.const 7))
        (then (i32.load8_u (i32.add (i32.const 0xB00000) (local.get $bi))))
        (else (i32.load8_u (i32.add (i32.const 0xA10000) (i32.sub (local.get $bi) (i32.const 7)))))))
      (local.set $bit (i32.and (i32.shr_u (local.get $byte) (i32.and (local.get $i) (i32.const 7))) (i32.const 1)))
      (call $put_bit (call $claim (local.get $C)) (local.get $bit))
      (local.set $i (i32.add (local.get $i) (i32.const 1)))
      (br $lp)))
    (i32.const 0))

  ;; --- decode(w,h) -> len>=0 ok | -1 magic miss | -2 length insane --------
  (func (export "decode") (param $w i32) (param $h i32) (result i32)
    (local $C i32) (local $i i32) (local $bit i32) (local $len i32) (local $total i32) (local $bi i32)
    (local.set $C (i32.mul (i32.const 3) (i32.mul (local.get $w) (local.get $h))))
    (global.set $state (global.get $seed))
    (call $clear_bitset (local.get $C))
    (i64.store (i32.const 0xB00000) (i64.const 0))            ;; clear 8 header bytes
    ;; read 56 header bits
    (local.set $i (i32.const 0))
    (block $hd (loop $hl
      (br_if $hd (i32.ge_u (local.get $i) (i32.const 56)))
      (local.set $bit (call $get_bit (call $claim (local.get $C))))
      (if (local.get $bit) (then
        (local.set $bi (i32.add (i32.const 0xB00000) (i32.shr_u (local.get $i) (i32.const 3))))
        (i32.store8 (local.get $bi) (i32.or (i32.load8_u (local.get $bi))
          (i32.shl (i32.const 1) (i32.and (local.get $i) (i32.const 7)))))))
      (local.set $i (i32.add (local.get $i) (i32.const 1)))
      (br $hl)))
    ;; magic + version check
    (if (i32.ne (i32.load8_u (i32.const 0xB00000)) (i32.const 0x4E)) (then (return (i32.const -1))))
    (if (i32.ne (i32.load8_u (i32.const 0xB00001)) (i32.const 0x53)) (then (return (i32.const -1))))
    (if (i32.ne (i32.load8_u (i32.const 0xB00002)) (i32.const 0x01)) (then (return (i32.const -1))))
    (local.set $len (i32.load offset=0xB00003 align=1 (i32.const 0)))
    (local.set $total (i32.add (i32.const 56) (i32.mul (i32.const 8) (local.get $len))))
    (if (i32.gt_u (local.get $total) (local.get $C)) (then (return (i32.const -2))))
    (memory.fill (i32.const 0xA10000) (i32.const 0) (local.get $len))
    ;; read payload bits, continuing the same draw sequence
    (local.set $i (i32.const 0))
    (block $pd (loop $pl
      (br_if $pd (i32.ge_u (local.get $i) (i32.mul (i32.const 8) (local.get $len))))
      (local.set $bit (call $get_bit (call $claim (local.get $C))))
      (if (local.get $bit) (then
        (local.set $bi (i32.add (i32.const 0xA10000) (i32.shr_u (local.get $i) (i32.const 3))))
        (i32.store8 (local.get $bi) (i32.or (i32.load8_u (local.get $bi))
          (i32.shl (i32.const 1) (i32.and (local.get $i) (i32.const 7)))))))
      (local.set $i (i32.add (local.get $i) (i32.const 1)))
      (br $pl)))
    (local.get $len))
)

metadata.name: V1
metadata.description: the 🔓 Decode view pane: ONE file upload → B2, password → B3, and B4 rendered as a clickable link when it is a URL. The contrast with the sibling: a single upload, no cover.

cels.f:
=view('🔓 Decode',
	dom('div', style('padding', '.75rem', 'display', 'flex', 'flex-direction', 'column', 'gap', '.55rem', 'max-width', '620px', 'font-family', 'system-ui, sans-serif'),
		dom('h2', style('margin', '0'), '🔓 Decode'),
		dom('div', style('color', '#666', 'font-size', '.9rem'),
			'Upload the ONE image you saved from X and type the password. No original cover needed — NanoSteg re-derives the hidden pixels from the password alone.'),
		dom('div', style('display', 'flex', 'flex-direction', 'column', 'gap', '.15rem'),
			dom('label', style('font-weight', '600'), 'image from X (PNG)'),
			dom('input', attr('type', 'file'), attr('accept', 'image/png'), on('change', 'fs.pickToCel', 'nanostegapp.B2')),
			dom('div', style('font-size', '.8rem', 'color', '#2a8f56'), IF(B2 = '', '', '✓ image loaded'))),
		dom('div', style('display', 'flex', 'flex-direction', 'column', 'gap', '.15rem'),
			dom('label', style('font-weight', '600'), 'password'),
			dom('input', attr('value', B3), style('padding', '.3rem'), on('input', 'param.set', 'nanostegapp.B3'))),
		dom('div', style('margin-top', '.5rem', 'padding', '.6rem', 'background', '#f4f4f7', 'border-radius', '.45rem'),
			IF(B2 = '',
				dom('span', style('color', '#999'), 'waiting for an image…'),
				IF(LEFT(B4, 4) = 'http',
					dom('div',
						dom('div', style('font-size', '.8rem', 'color', '#666', 'margin-bottom', '.2rem'), 'recovered link:'),
						dom('a', attr('href', B4), attr('target', '_blank'), style('word-break', 'break-all', 'color', '#2563eb'), B4)),
					dom('div', style('word-break', 'break-all'), B4))))))

	dom('div', style('padding', '.75rem', 'display', 'flex', 'flex-direction', 'column', 'gap', '.55rem', 'max-width', '620px', 'font-family', 'system-ui, sans-serif'),

		dom('div', style('margin-top', '.5rem'),
			IF(F2 = '',
				dom('span', style('color', '#999'), 'pick a cover PNG to embed…'),
				IF(F1 = '',

manifests.name: nanostegapp
manifests.description: NanoSteg — a WAT-native, dependency-free sheetapp document that hides a plastron.ca #f= link inside a small PNG and recovers it BLINDLY from that one image plus a password (no original cover). The whole steg algorithm is hand-written WebAssembly text ON THE SHEET (a positioned kind:"wat" cell whose live instance is captured for pixel-buffer I/O); every decision — the password, the ≤680px guard, the capacity guard, the embed/decode compositions, the clickable-link result — is a positioned cell. The lightweight, no-Python contrast to the ChaosEdgeSteg sibling.
